tbesh_html:
A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 1Ch.23.10;
son of: Shimei (H8096G);
brother of: Jahath (H3189I), Zizah (H2126) and Jeush (H3266J)
§ Beriah = "with a friend"
1) a son of Asher
2) a son of Ephraim
3) a Benjamite
4) a Levite

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Beriah, the name of four Israelites
strongs_1890.derivation: apparently from the feminine of H7451 (רַע) with a prepositional prefix; in trouble;
